trucks: GET /api/trucks (public) — list + search/filter/sort, query: search, category_id, condition, fuel_type, transmission, min_price, max_price, is_for_sale, is_for_rent, status, sort(newest|oldest|price_asc|price_desc), per_page
GET /api/trucks/{id} (public) — detail + images + specifications + seller + reviews
DELETE /api/trucks/{id} (admin / owner seller) — soft delete via status
POST /api/trucks/{id}/images (admin / owner seller) — multipart field: image, is_primary
GET /api/wishlists (customer, auth) — daftar truck yang disimpan
leads: POST /api/leads (public) — form hubungi sales: name, phone, message, truck_id, source
PUT /api/leads/{id} (sales / admin) — status: new, contacted, negotiating, won, lost; sales_id (penugasan); notes
users: GET /api/users (admin) — daftar pengguna, filter role (mis. ?role=sales) untuk dropdown penugasan
rentals: GET /api/rentals (customer: milik sendiri; admin: semua) — filter truck_id, status
POST /api/rentals (customer) — booking: truck_id, start_date, end_date, notes; cek ketersediaan; total = harga harian x jumlah hari; status awal pending
PUT /api/rentals/{id} (customer: hanya batalkan pending/confirmed; admin: ubah status/dates/notes)
orange_products: GET /api/oranges (public) — list + search/filter/sort: search, category_id, grade, min_price, max_price, in_stock, status, sort, per_page
GET /api/oranges/{id} (public) — detail + images + category + seller + reviews
PUT /api/oranges/{id} (admin / owner seller) — termasuk update stok & harga
DELETE /api/oranges/{id} (admin / owner seller) — soft delete via status
POST /api/oranges/{id}/images (admin / owner seller) — multipart: image, is_primary
orders: GET /api/orders (customer: milik sendiri; admin: semua) — filter status, payment_status

POST /api/orders (customer) — checkout: items[orange_product_id, quantity_kg], address (inline) atau shipping_address_id, shipping_cost, notes, delivery{...}; kurangi stok; harga grosir otomatis untuk quantity_kg >= 50; buat delivery bila diminta
PUT /api/orders/{id}/status (admin) — status: pending, confirmed, processing, completed, cancelled; payment_status: unpaid, paid, refunded; shipping_cost
delivery: PUT /api/deliveries/{id}/status (admin) — pending, assigned, in_transit, delivered, cancelled; delivered_at otomatis
dashboard: GET /api/dashboard (auth, semua role) — ringkasan statistik sesuai role: admin (truck/rental/order/lead/user/orange counts, revenue, recent orders/leads/rentals), sales (lead counts per status + recent leads), truck_seller (truck & lead counts + recent), orange_seller (produk & stok + recent products), customer (order/rental/wishlist counts + recent)

notes.wholesale_rule: harga grosir otomatis berlaku bila quantity_kg >= 50 dan wholesale_price terisi
notes.orange_rules: wholesale_price harus <= price_per_kg; stok dalam kg; minimum_order_kg default 1
notes.rental_price_source: kolom rental_price_per_day pada truck; harga sewa harus diisi saat truck ditandai is_for_rent
